sentences.text: Shri Durgesh Singh Singrore - Advocate for the appellant.

Shri Arvind Singh -
Government Advocate for the State.

Per Smt. Justice Anuradha Shukla :
Heard on I.A.No.28112/2024, which is first application filed under Section 389(1) of
Cr.P.C. for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail on behalf of sole appellant
Captan Singh Dhurve .

The appellant was convicted for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act, Life imprisonment with fine of Rs.25000/- and Section 366A of IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for 3 years with fine of Rs,.2000/-
with default stipulations, vide judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 27.09.2024 passed by the Special Judge (POCSO) Act, Baihar, district Balaghat, in Special Case No.07/2022.
This first application for seeking suspension of sentence has been argued on the ground that the age of prosecutrix was not proved by any convincing evidence.
The DNA report received in this case was inconclusive in nature for the reason that no male DNA profile was obtained from the source of victim.
It has also been argued that MLC report of victim did not establish the fact of commission of rape.
Arguing on the ground of age of victim, reliance has been placed on the hostile testimony of father of victim (P.W.10), who failed to prove the date of birth of prosecutrix.

It has also 2 CRA-11925-2024 been argued that teacher Deepak Tiwari (P.W.7) who proved the scholar register entry (Ex.P.31/29) and declaration register (Ex.P.32/30 ) has admitted that the date of birth of prosecutrix was informed by her father, but it is submitted that father himself was not aware about this date of birth, therefore, school entries cannot be relied upon.
The State has opposed this application for suspension of sentence.
Counsel for both the parties have been heard and the record is perused.

sentences.text: Having heard the arguments of parties and on examining the evidence available on record, we deem it appropriate to suspend the jail sentence of appellant and to release him on bail.

Therefore,
without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, appellant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court for his appearance before the concerned trial Court firstly on 27.02.2025 and on such other dates as may be fixed by the concerned Court in this regard, till final disposal of this appeal.
List for final hearing in due course.
(SUSHRUT ARVIND DHARMADHIKARI) (ANURADHA  JUDGE JUD
